publication: Wagman et al. (1982), The NBS Tables of Chemical Thermodynamic Properties, JPCRD 11 Supplement 2, Table 22; NIST Atomic Spectra Database, Bi II energy levels.
source_note: The NBS formation enthalpy anchors a monatomic ideal-gas function. The NIST Bi II term levels provide its electronic partition function over the fitted interval.
